svg.title: Sections of the structured summary
svg.desc: What happened: concise summary, contact information, and call intents with the agent's solutions. Call signals: repeated issue and call transfers. What's next: next steps for the caller and the agent, and future call watchouts. Entities: benefits, specialists, diseases and procedures.
svg.text: key events, amounts, dates · under 200 words
caller, who it's about, caller type (enum)
one topic per intent, 20 words or fewer + solution
0 or 1 · count, excluding the survey transfer
what the caller still has to do
what to watch for if they call again
